note: No [[identity.partition]]: the declared split 1.5.kon names the native family's columns implicitly, and two spellings of one column that are never delivered together in one year fold onto it.
fails_if: `convert_column_partitions` matches the split suffix against column names case-sensitively, or treats non-co-delivered case twins as competing literals, so KON (or Kon) stays on the unnamed native family

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers column Kon in 2020 (CVID 20) and KON in 2021 (CVID 21).
